purpose: Give geographically sympatric and allopatric plant pairs ecological/geographic context descriptors without using flower colour to define the descriptors.
geography_source: the frozen G5 GBIF plant-occupancy frame
reference_population: all eligible plant-pair opportunities under the frozen occupancy/taxonomic/data-coverage gates before flower-colour inference

thresholds.similarity_turnover_axes: at or below the 25th percentile of an external turnover/distance score
thresholds.separation_turnover_axes: at or above the 75th percentile of an external turnover/distance score
thresholds.direct_barrier_zero_guard: if the 75th percentile of a direct-barrier reference is zero, a zero-valued pair is never called separated; only strictly positive barrier intensity qualifies. If Q75 is positive, require value >= Q75.
thresholds.constant_or_sparse_reference: not_evaluable for that axis; never recoded as similar or separated

rules.predictor_direction: all stored external pair scores increase with turnover/separation/barrier intensity

uses.G5_context_strata: Interpret whether colour convergence/divergence differs among externally similar versus separated contexts.
uses.allopatry_characterization: Describe whether a non-overlapping pair is especially separated in climate, soil, pollinator landscape, topography, marine gaps, rivers, biogeographic boundaries or mountains.
uses.sympatry_characterization: Describe shared ecological context of a co-occurring pair without assuming facilitation, competition, mimicry or reproductive interference.

claim_ceiling: These are outcome-blind pair-context descriptors. A label such as climate-separated or marine-gap-separated does not mean that climate or the marine gap caused allopatry, and pollinator-similar does not establish shared selective pressure.
